integrity: Finite computation is supplementary. All asymptotic and infinite-moment claims are based on explicit analytic arguments. Publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Proves one-dimensional exact-load Poisson P1 FEM statements for independent uniform-order-statistic knots and unpreconditioned Euclidean nodal stiffness; does not cover bounded mesh perturbations, preconditioners, finite-precision solves, other loads, or higher dimensions.
title: A Fréchet conditioning penalty alongside exact energy error on uniform random finite-element meshes
